ruleDefinitions.name: AWS S3 Data Management Tampering
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user tampers with S3 data management in Amazon Web Services. Note: Unmapped fields: eventSource, eventName

sequences.query: (eventSource = "s3\.amazonaws\.com" AND (eventName = "PutBucketLogging" OR eventName = "PutBucketWebsite" OR eventName = "PutEncryptionConfiguration" OR eventName = "PutLifecycleConfiguration" OR eventName = "PutReplicationConfiguration" OR eventName = "ReplicateObject" OR eventName = "RestoreObject"))
